snippet.title: Neat! - Get Hired to Sort & Organize Spaces - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Feeling overwhelmed? Hi, I’m Molly. I help people sort their space, organize their belongings, and bring calm back into their lives. Let’s take it one object at a time and make everything feel neat again. Tell me your story. I’m here to listen.

Play the free demo on Steam!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4300090/Neat/
